request_types: pulley effort with explicitly supplied efficiency
examined_surface.model_scope: Two simple-machine models; original role grammar and finite unit conversions, not the entire mechanism catalogue.

cases.request: A lever has effort arm 40 cm and load arm 0.2 m. What is its ideal mechanical advantage?
cases.observed_behavior: {"status": "answered", "kind": "lever_ma", "value": 2, "response": "The mechanical advantage is 2 (effort arm 0.4 / load arm 0.2)."}; reviewed outcome: right

cases.request: A pulley has 4 supporting strands and a 400 N load. Its efficiency is 50%. What effort is required?
cases.expected_boundary: Work efficiency eta = output/input and ideal displacement ratio4 imply effort=400/(4*0.5)=200 N; alternatively withhold unsupported efficiency.
cases.observed_behavior: {"status": "answered", "kind": "pulley_effort", "value": 100, "response": "The effort is 100 N (load 400 N / 4 supporting strands; ideal, frictionless)."}; reviewed outcome: wrong
